slug: 2025-11-09 Cameroon aims to connect 328 rural communities by 2028 (PATNUC)

facts.fact: Business in Cameroon reports that the Posts and Telecommunications Minister opened bidding on 31 October 2025 for the rural connectivity component of the World Bank-backed PATNUC, funded with 55 billion XAF, to connect 328 unserved 3G localities by 2028.

note: Statement on access to information; community radio expansion and accessibility prize are not rural internet programmes and no rural or urban use figures are given.

facts.fact: PATNUC says a strategic meeting in Yaounde on 8 July 2025 prepared World Bank-financed 3G coverage for 328 rural white-zone localities, with a tender for 120 firm sites and 208 conditional sites targeted before 30 December 2026.
MINPOSTEL, with World Bank support under PATNUC, validated a national universal digital service strategy on 8 July 2025 whose deployment axis aims at full coverage of underserved areas by 2030.

note: No rural connectivity programme or measurement stated.

facts.fact: Cameroon Tribune reports that the posts and telecoms minister assessed the connectivity infrastructure installed at Campo Beach, under the PATNUC rural connectivity programme planned for 362 under-served localities, with nine such infrastructures in the Ocean department.
Orange Cameroon says 40 of 120 white-zone sites under the government-led, World Bank-supported PATNUC project had been commissioned by 13 November 2026, with all 120 due by March 2027.

facts.fact: Under the World Bank-financed PATNUC project, which aims to connect 362 rural localities, MTN Cameroon is building 182 sites of which more than 30 are reported operational, with Ekpwassong I connected on 9 November 2026 and Bisso'o on 11 November 2026.

Posts and Telecommunications Minister Minette Libom Li Likeng said 67 telecommunications sites had been brought into service under a World Bank-backed programme targeting 362 rural communities with limited or no coverage.
